text: The blood work shows severe anemia with low hemoglobin and low platelets, but your white blood cell count is dangerously high and your reticulocyte count is normal, suggesting your bone marrow is not responding to the anemia. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia

The combination of severe anemia, thrombocytopenia, and marked leukocytosis with a normal reticulocyte count strongly suggests bone marrow failure due to leukemia. Since you denied fever and weight loss, I need to confirm if you have noticed any swollen lymph nodes, abdominal fullness, or gum changes, and I will request an examination of your blood smear and lymph nodes.
